title: Staying Healthy Is Important
article_en: It is important to stay healthy. We can eat different foods to be healthy. Eating vegetables is beautiful for our body. Exercise makes us strong and happy. We should exercise every day. Also, good sleep is important. We need to sleep at night. Then we can have energy.
article_zh: 保持健康很重要。我们可以吃不同的食物来保持健康。吃蔬菜对身体很 beneficial。锻炼让我们强壮和快乐。我们应该每天锻炼。此外，良好的睡眠也很重要。我们需要在晚上睡觉。这样我们才有精力。

grammar_points.name: It is + adj. + to do
grammar_points.explanation: 用it作形式主语，真正的主语是后面的不定式。
grammar_points.example: It is important to stay healthy.

grammar_points.name: Verb + object
grammar_points.explanation: 动词后接宾语构成动宾结构。
grammar_points.example: Eating vegetables is beautiful for our body.

sentence_patterns.example: It is important to stay healthy.
Eating vegetables is beautiful for our body.
